root_cause: The global language selector was mounted against an older shared-mobile navigation selector, while the production V18 mobile drawer is built with data-bg-mobile-view. The release therefore passed code/build checks but the control was absent from the actual mobile menu shown to visitors.
prevention: Language controls must target the active canonical V18 mobile root data-bg-mobile-view=root as well as legacy selectors during migration.
Runtime navigation created after i18n initialization must trigger idempotent language-control remounting.
A site-wide UI control is not production-proven from static source inspection alone; exact production mobile navigation readback must verify visible placement and interaction.
The language selector must remain inside navigation and never occupy the floating WhatsApp/content layer.
evidence: production screenshot 2026-09-21 showing V18 mobile drawer without language selector before recovery
